name: Aathur Kichadi Samba Aval (ஆத்தூர் கிச்சடி சம்பா அவல்)
short_description_en: Aval from Aathur Kichadi Samba, the fine white samba rice of the Aathur region. Light, pale flakes with a clean taste — ideal for curd aval, lemon aval and upma. 500 g pack.

name: Arubathaam Kuruvai Aval (அறுபதாம் குறுவை அவல்)
short_description_en: Aval from Arubathaam Kuruvai, the sixty-day heirloom kuruvai paddy. Small, thin flakes that soak in moments — handy for quick breakfasts, aval kanji and evening snacks. 500 g pack.

name: Bamboo Aval (மூங்கில் அவல்)
short_description_en: Aval from bamboo seed rice (Mungil Arisi), gathered only in the years bamboo flowers, which makes it rare. Greenish flakes with a distinct aroma — used for aval kanji, sweet aval and puttu. 500 g pack.

name: Iluppai Poo Samba Aval (இலுப்பைப் பூ சம்பா அவல்)
short_description_en: Aval pounded from Iluppai Poo Samba, the heirloom samba paddy prized for its mild iluppai-flower aroma. Medium flakes that soften with a short soak — good for upma, poha and sweet aval. 500 g pack.

name: Kalanamak Aval (காலா நமக் அவல்)
short_description_en: Aval pounded from Kalanamak, the aromatic black-husked heirloom paddy of the Terai. The flakes keep a gentle fragrance — lovely in sweet aval, kheer and poha. 500 g pack.

name: Kallundai Samba Aval (கல்லுண்டை சம்பா அவல்)
short_description_en: Aval from Kallundai Samba, the round, bold-grained Tamil heirloom samba paddy. Thick, hearty flakes that hold their shape — best for upma, aval payasam and savoury mixtures. 500 g pack.

name: Karudan Samba Aval (கருடன் சம்பா அவல்)
short_description_en: Aval from Karudan Samba, a sturdy traditional samba paddy. These are thicker flakes that hold their shape after soaking — suited to upma, spiced aval and aval kanji. 500 g pack.

name: Karunguruvai Aval (கருங்குருவை அவல்)
short_description_en: Aval from Karunguruvai, a short-duration heirloom paddy of the Cauvery delta. Dark-toned flakes with a firm bite that hold their shape — used for upma, aval kanji and curd aval. 500 g pack.

name: Karuppu Kavuni Aval (கருப்பு கவுனி அவல்)
short_description_en: Aval pressed from Karuppu Kavuni, the traditional black paddy of Tamil Nadu. It keeps its deep purple colour and a mildly nutty taste — used for sweet aval, aval payasam and puttu. 500 g pack.

name: Kattu Yanam Aval (காட்டுயானம் அவல்)
short_description_en: Aval from Kattu Yanam, a tall traditional paddy of Tamil Nadu. Reddish-brown flakes with a distinct aroma — used for upma, aval puttu and curd aval. 500 g pack.

name: Kichadi Samba Aval (கிச்சடி சம்பா அவல்)
short_description_en: Aval from Kichadi Samba, a soft-grained samba paddy. The flakes stay separate rather than turning pasty — the natural choice for aval kichadi, upma and curd aval. 500 g pack.

name: Kudavaazhai Aval (குடவாழை அவல்)
short_description_en: Aval from Kudavaazhai, a traditional paddy of the Cauvery irrigated tracts, named for its plantain-like leaf sheath. Whole flakes with the bran left on — used for upma, jaggery aval and puttu. 500 g pack.

name: Kuzhakkan / Kullakar Aval (குழக்கன் / குள்ளக்கார் அவல்)
short_description_en: Aval from Kuzhakkan (also called Kullakar), a red rain-fed paddy of southern Tamil Nadu. Dense red flakes that soak well — used for upma, jaggery aval and aval kanji. 500 g pack.

name: Mappillai Samba Aval (மாப்பிள்ளை சம்பா அவல்)
short_description_en: Aval made from Mappillai Samba, the red heirloom paddy traditionally served to bridegrooms. The red bran is left on, giving it a firm bite — good for upma, spiced aval and jaggery aval. 500 g pack.

name: Poongar Aval (பூங்கார் அவல்)
short_description_en: Aval from Poongar, a small-grained red paddy long used in traditional Tamil home cooking. The flakes are thin and soften quickly — good for upma, aval kanji and sweet aval. 500 g pack.

name: Ratha Sali Aval (ரத்த சாலி அவல்)
short_description_en: Aval from Ratha Sali, a deep red heirloom paddy named in old Tamil texts. The flakes keep their red colour and need a slightly longer soak — used for aval kanji, jaggery aval and puttu. 500 g pack.

name: Thuya Malli Aval (தூய மல்லி அவல்)
short_description_en: Aval from Thuya Malli, a small fragrant white paddy. The flakes are thin and soften with a single rinse — the easiest of the set for curd aval, upma and aval mixture. 500 g pack.

name: Coconut Oil (தேங்காய் எண்ணெய்)
short_description_en: Pure cold-pressed coconut oil.

name: Gingelly Oil (நல்லெண்ணெய்)
short_description_en: Traditional nallennai pressed in a wooden chekku in small batches — no heat and no chemical refining, so the sesame keeps its own aroma and colour. For tempering, everyday cooking, idli milagai podi and traditional oil baths.

name: Groundnut Oil (கடலை எண்ணெய்)
short_description_en: Pure groundnut oil.

name: Horse Gram Oil (கொள்ளு எண்ணெய்)
short_description_en: Cold-pressed oil from horse gram (kollu), made in small batches with no solvents. A traditional Tamil preparation with a distinct nutty aroma, used sparingly in cooking and for external application. 500 ml bottle.

name: Malamattu Ghee (மாளமாட்டு நெய்)
short_description_en: Native cow bilona ghee.

name: All-Age Nutrition Malt Mix (அனைத்து வயதினருக்கான ஊட்டச்சத்து மாவுக் கலவை)
short_description_en: A millet-and-nut nutrition malt for everyone from grandparents to children. Stir into hot milk for a malt-style drink, or into water; natural sweeteners only, no artificial flavouring. Good between meals.

name: Diabetic-Friendly Porridge & Dosa Flour (நீரிழிவு நோயாளிகளுக்கான கஞ்சி, தோசை மாவு)
short_description_en: Low-glycaemic millet mix.

name: Gut & Body Cleansing Tea (குடல் மற்றும் உடல் தூய்மைக்கான தேநீர்)
short_description_en: An Agasthiyar-style herbal tea made from 21 herbs, traditionally taken to cleanse the body and gut. Boil a spoonful in a glass of water, strain and drink warm, usually first thing in the morning. Not a medicine.

name: Kali & Porridge Flour (களி, கஞ்சி மாவு)
short_description_en: Traditional millets and pulses roasted and then stone-ground, which is where the deeper flavour comes from. No sugar, colour or preservatives. Stir it thin for kanji or thick for kali, and eat with jaggery or buttermilk.

name: Panchakara Herbal Drink (பஞ்சகர குடிநீர்)
short_description_en: Panchakara kudineer: a decoction of five traditional ingredients, traditionally favoured by people who practise meditation (dhyanam), with no chemical adulteration. Also taken as a hot kashayam for a cold or after a heavy meal. Boil in a glass of water, strain, and drink hot.

name: Protein Mix (புரதச்சத்துக் கலவை)
short_description_en: A plant-based protein mix made from sprouted pulses, millets and nuts, with no synthetic isolates and no additives. Made for people who train. Mix into milk or water after a workout, or take it as a filling breakfast.

name: Roasted Kali & Porridge Dosa Flour (வறுத்த களி, கஞ்சி தோசை மாவு)
short_description_en: Dual-purpose kanji and dosai mix.

name: Weight Loss Porridge Flour (உடல் எடை குறைப்புக்கான கஞ்சி மாவு)
short_description_en: High-fibre satiety kanji mix.

name: Women’s Uterine Health Flour (பெண்களின் கருப்பை நல மாவு)
short_description_en: A traditional nutrition flour for women’s uterine health: millets, pulses, nuts and seeds chosen with iron and calcium in mind, roasted and ground with no additives. Cook with water or milk into a porridge, sweetened with jaggery if you like. A food, not a medicine.

name: Herbal Bath Powder (மூலிகைக் குளியல் பொடி)
short_description_en: A traditional bath powder of green gram, herbs and roots, used in place of soap — no soap and no sulphates. Mix with water or milk into a paste, rub on and rinse off. Suits use a few times a week.

name: Shikakai Powder (சீயக்காய்த் தூள்)
short_description_en: Natural shikakai hair wash.

name: Honey (தேன்)
short_description_en: Raw honey collected straight from the comb — not heated, not filtered, and with no sugar syrup or additives. Crystallising over time is normal for raw honey, not a fault. Not to be given to children under one year. 250 g jar.

name: Bengal Gram Dal (கடலைப் பருப்பு)
short_description_en: Split bengal gram with a firm bite and a mildly sweet taste, cleaned and graded, holding its shape after cooking. Soak for 30 minutes and it cooks evenly. Used in sambar, sundal, vadai and traditional sweets.

name: Black Chickpeas (கருப்பு கொண்டைக்கடலை)
short_description_en: Black chickpeas.

name: Black Urad Dal (கருப்பு உளுந்து)
short_description_en: Whole black urad with skin.

name: Green Gram (பச்சைப் பயறு)
short_description_en: Whole green gram.

name: Groundnuts (நிலக்கடலை)
short_description_en: Raw groundnuts.

name: Horse Gram (கொள்ளு)
short_description_en: Kollu, a dryland pulse long used in Tamil cooking, rich in protein, iron and fibre. Soak overnight and boil — the cooking water itself is used as kollu rasam. Also roasted and ground for thuvaiyal, or made into sundal.

name: Moong Dal (பாசிப்பருப்பு)
short_description_en: Split yellow moong dal.

name: Pigeon Pea Dal (துவரம் பருப்பு)
short_description_en: Unpolished toor dal.

name: Sesame Seeds (எள்)
short_description_en: Whole sesame seeds.

name: Split Green Gram (சிறுபருப்பு)
short_description_en: Small red lentil.

name: White Chickpeas (வெள்ளை கொண்டைக்கடலை)
short_description_en: Even-sized white chickpeas, cleaned and graded, that soften on cooking while holding their shape. High in plant protein and fibre. Soak overnight, drain, and boil in fresh water for channa masala, sundal, gravies or salads.

name: White Urad Dal (வெள்ளை உளுந்து)
short_description_en: Whole white urad dal.

name: Chilli Powder (மிளகாய்த் தூள்)
short_description_en: Roasted dals, chilli and sesame ground coarse the traditional way, the sesame adding both flavour and body. No artificial colour or preservatives. Mix with sesame oil for idli and dosa, or with ghee into hot rice.

name: Curry Powder (குழம்புத் தூள்)
short_description_en: Traditional kuzhambu masala.

name: Rasam Powder (ரசத் தூள்)
short_description_en: Pepper, cumin, coriander and toor dal roasted and ground in small batches, a pepper-and-cumin-forward blend with no artificial colour or preservatives. A spoonful makes a clear, hot rasam. Store in an airtight container.

name: Sambar Powder (சாம்பார் தூள்)
short_description_en: Traditional sambar masala.

name: Turmeric Powder (மஞ்சள் தூள்)
short_description_en: Pure turmeric powder collected direct from trusted organic farmers, with no chemical adulteration and no artificial colouring — the colour and the earthy aroma are its own. For everyday cooking and kuzhambu; keep in an airtight container.

name: Barnyard Millet (குதிரைவாலி)
short_description_en: High-fibre barnyard millet.

name: Finger Millet (கேழ்வரகு)
short_description_en: Whole finger millet.

name: Foxtail Millet (திணை)
short_description_en: Traditional foxtail millet.

name: Kodo Millet (வரகு)
short_description_en: Hardy kodo millet.

name: Little Millet (சாமை)
short_description_en: Saamai, one of the millets grown in Tamil Nadu for generations, collected direct from organic farmers then cleaned and graded with nothing added. The lightest of the millets and quick to cook. Store airtight, somewhere cool and out of sunlight.

name: Pearl Millet (கம்பு)
short_description_en: Whole pearl millet.

name: Sorghum (சோளம்)
short_description_en: A gluten-free whole grain with a mild taste that takes to everyday cooking, grown by organic methods and carrying protein, fibre and calcium. Soak a few hours before cooking. Use as cholam rice or kanji, or grind into flour for soft rotti.

name: Country Jaggery (நாட்டுச் சர்க்கரை)
short_description_en: Unrefined cane sugar, never bleached, so the light brown colour and the natural minerals stay in. Mild-tasting and ground fine enough to stand in directly for white sugar in coffee, tea and sweets. Store airtight, away from damp.

name: Palm Jaggery (கருப்பட்டி)
short_description_en: Traditional palm jaggery blocks.

name: Palm Sugar Crystals (பனங்கற்கண்டு)
short_description_en: Panangkarkandu crystallised from palm jaggery, with a clean, cooling sweetness and no artificial colour or flavouring. Traditionally taken with warm milk or ghee to soothe the throat. Store airtight, away from damp.

name: Round Jaggery (உருண்டை வெல்லம்)
short_description_en: Round cane jaggery balls.

name: Barley Rice (பார்லி அரிசி / வாற்கோதுமை)
short_description_en: Whole barley grain, cleaned and graded, cooked in place of rice or simmered into kanji. Soak for an hour, then boil with three parts water. 500 g pack.

name: Idli Rice (இட்லி அரிசி)
short_description_en: Parboiled rice for idli batter.

name: Ponni Rice (பொன்னி அரிசி)
short_description_en: Everyday Ponni rice.

name: Aathur Kichadi Samba Rice (ஆத்தூர் கிச்சடி சம்பா அரிசி)
short_description_en: Aathur Kichadi Samba, the fine white samba rice associated with the Aathur region of Tamil Nadu. Slender grain that cooks soft and separate. Suited to everyday rice, variety rice and pongal. 1 kg pack.

name: Arubathaam Kuruvai Rice (அறுபதாம் குறுவை அரிசி)
short_description_en: Arubathaam Kuruvai, the short-season heirloom paddy traditionally harvested around sixty days, as its name says. Small, unpolished grain, hand-pounded. Soak before cooking; good for rice, idli and kanji. 1 kg pack.

name: Bamboo Rice (மூங்கில் அரிசி)
short_description_en: Rare forest bamboo rice.

name: Iluppai Poo Samba Rice (இலுப்பைப் பூ சம்பா அரிசி)
short_description_en: Iluppai Poo Samba, a Tamil heirloom samba paddy named for the faint iluppai-flower aroma of its cooked grain. Hand-pounded and unpolished. Soak before cooking; suited to plain rice and pongal. 1 kg pack.

name: Kalanamak Rice (காலா நமக் அரிசி)
short_description_en: Kalanamak, the aromatic black-husked heirloom paddy of the Terai foothills, known for its fragrance and soft short grain. Unpolished. Soak before cooking; suited to plain rice, pulao and kheer. 1 kg pack.

name: Kallundai Samba Rice (கல்லுண்டை சம்பா அரிசி)
short_description_en: Kallundai Samba, a sturdy Tamil heirloom samba paddy with a round, bold grain. Hand-pounded and unpolished, it cooks firm and filling. Soak before cooking; suited to rice, kanji and tiffin. 1 kg pack.

name: Karudan Samba Rice (கருடன் சம்பா அரிசி)
short_description_en: Hardy traditional samba rice.

name: Karunguruvai Rice (கருங்குறுவை அரிசி)
short_description_en: Karunguruvai, a short-duration heirloom paddy of the Kuruvai season with a dark husk and firm grain. Hand-pounded and unpolished. Soak before cooking; suited to everyday rice and kanji. 1 kg pack.

name: Karuppu Kavuni Rice (கருப்பு கவுனி அரிசி)
short_description_en: Kavuni, a traditional black rice of Tamil Nadu, cooks to a deep purple with a nutty aroma. Soak at least four hours before cooking. Used for puttu, kanji and traditional sweets. 1 kg pack.

name: Kattu Yanam Rice (காட்டு யானம் அரிசி)
short_description_en: Kattu Yanam, a tall traditional paddy named for its elephant-high crop, giving a reddish unpolished grain. Hand-pounded. Soak before cooking; suited to everyday rice and kanji. 1 kg pack.

name: Kichili Samba Rice (கிச்சிலி சம்பா அரிசி)
short_description_en: Traditional broken samba rice.

name: Kudavaazhai Rice (குடவாழை அரிசி)
short_description_en: Traditional heritage rice.

name: Kuzhakkan / Kullakar Rice (குழக்கான் / குள்ளக்கார் அரிசி)
short_description_en: Kullakar, also called Kuzhakkan, is a short red heirloom paddy grown in southern Tamil Nadu. Hand-pounded and unpolished. Soak before cooking; suited to rice, kanji and puttu. 1 kg pack.

name: Mappillai Samba Rice (மாப்பிள்ளை சம்பா அரிசி)
short_description_en: Mappillai Samba, a red heirloom rice long grown in Tamil Nadu and traditionally served at weddings. Hand-pounded, with the bran left on. Soak before cooking; suited to rice, kanji and puttu. 1 kg pack.

name: Poongar Rice (பூங்கார் அரிசி)
short_description_en: Poongar, a flood-tolerant heirloom paddy of southern Tamil Nadu with a small reddish grain. Hand-pounded and unpolished. Soak before cooking; suited to rice, kanji and puttu. 1 kg pack.

name: Ratha Sali Rice (ரத்தசாலி அரிசி)
short_description_en: Rathasali, a deep red heirloom rice named for the colour of its grain. Hand-pounded and unpolished. Soak before cooking; suited to rice, kanji and puttu. 1 kg pack.

name: Thuya Malli Rice (தூய மல்லி அரிசி)
short_description_en: Thuya Malli, a fine white heirloom rice named for its jasmine-like grain, with a light natural fragrance. Cooks soft and separate — suited to everyday meals, biryani and pongal. 1 kg pack.
